L0_sample_identification_region.interpretation: Sample identification region over the realized measured-eligible confirmatory sample. It is not a confidence interval, population interval, or whole-benchmark prevalence interval.

L1_separate_endpoint_sampling_intervals.method: Clopper-Pearson 95%, conditional on realized m; endpoints remain separate

L2_preregistered_measurement_sensitivity.interpretation: Measurement sensitivity only; separate from L0 and L1.

vo_interpretation.VO_DEFECT: VO-DEFECT was not executed because its independent evidence-production and attestation procedure was insufficiently operationalized in the frozen instrument.
vo_interpretation.VO_zero_meaning: No obstruction was established by the valid frozen VO procedure. This does not mean that no obstruction exists.
